group.label: Memoirs · The Shadow That Signals Victory

lines.text: I heard that a name had been decided for that giant ship, the massive shadow that had saved me twice: the Wings of Victory. They say it was named that because it's a mobile base that carries the Goddesses of Victory into battle. I couldn't think of a more fitting name myself.

After hearing what it was named, my desire to see it again kept growing every time I was out on the battlefield. It's funny because I used to get uneasy whenever a massive shadow fell on me, since I thought some enormous Rapture had appeared in the sky.
I wonder if I'll see that shadow today.
